excerpt.zh: 维度锁正在失去稳定。我们需要尽快行动避免它完全松脱。
excerpt.en: This Dimensional Lock is destabilizing. We will need to work quickly to prevent it from completely unraveling.

texts.zh: 维度锁正在失去稳定。我们需要尽快行动避免它完全松脱。
texts.en: This Dimensional Lock is destabilizing. We will need to work quickly to prevent it from completely unraveling.

tooltips.zh: 维度锁激活期间，只有得到你允许的舰队可以进入。
tooltips.en: While Dimensional Locks are active, only those fleets with your permission may enter.

tooltips.zh: 维度锁将会过期，将需要由科研船来重新建立。
tooltips.en: This Dimensional Lock will expire, and will need to be re-established with a Science Ship.
